basis: Prepared from actual preserved images, re-viewed full/crops by packet builder. Historical T-0675 double readings consulted only to identify reservations; they are not infallible truth. Root must visually review especially B.r9.birth, B.r12.birth and right-page row alignment before freeze.

grading.normalization: Ignore whitespace, capitalization, punctuation and equivalent slash/fraction layout. Do not silently normalize a different date, a supplied full century, ditto, copied surname or other substituted content. State points refer to own-cell status. Content2=correct diplomatic raw;1=correct semantic reading but expanded century/name or incomplete role;0=wrong/omitted. For uncertainty reserve full credit when preference plus concrete alternative is reasonable. Generic everything-uncertain cannot earn all state points.
grading.manual_review: Blind to model/trial. Review unmatched spellings/glyph readings and critical errors against images; alternatives list is not exhaustive truth. Separate 5 crossout observations from75fieldscore; report count0–5, do not double-penalize per field.
grading.pass_proposal: At least68/75 and no confirmed critical error; frozen before trials.
